home.summary:
View, create and share your captions
with this open source browser extension

easyToUse.title: Easy to use
easyToUse.description: View captions without leaving <youtube>Youtube</youtube> and other supported <videosites>video sites</videosites>

advancedEffects.title: Advanced effects
advancedEffects.description: View complex captions made in Substation Alpha formats (SSA, ASS) using the advanced renderer made possible by <octopus>Subtitle Octopus</octopus>

convenientEditor.title: Convenient editor
convenientEditor.description:
Create captions with the built-in editor directly in a video's page with the extension.
Manual caption positioning, keyboard shortcuts are supported.
More features to come!

import.title: Import existing captions
import.description: Use tools such as Aegisub or SubtitleEdit to create captions before uploading them through NekoCap. <bold>SSA</bold>, <bold>ASS</bold>, <bold>SRT</bold>, <bold>VTT</bold>, <bold>SBV</bold> formats are supported

community.title: Community moderation
community.description:
NekoCap's website comes with tools to let community moderators verify or reject submitted captions.
However, we need volunteers who are fluent in different languages to help moderate submitted captions.
If you want to help, join the Discord and give us a ping!

view.title: How to view captions
view.step2: Watch videos on one of the supported video sites as usual
view.step3: If there are captions for the video, select them from the dropdown!

create.title: How to create captions
create.step3: Browse to the page containing the video you want to add a caption for
create.step4: Use the Nekocap editor to create a new caption or upload an existing caption file without leaving the video page!

home.twitterSuspensionNotice: Recently, the NekoCap X (Twitter) account has been wrongly suspended due to reports by apparently malicious person(s). Hence if you need to contact me, join the Discord or message me on Instagram.

intro.heading: Watch any video with community-made captions.
intro.description: NekoCap is a browser extension that drops community captions straight into YouTube, Vimeo, niconico, bilibili, TVer, Netflix and more, so anyone can subtitle a video, and anyone can watch it in their language.

features.heading: A captioning toolkit that respects the player you're already in.
features.subtitle: Say goodbye to re-uploads! Captions float over the original video and they're written by humans who love the content as much as you!

inPlayer.title: Captions in-player
inPlayer.description: Install the extension, open a video, pick a caption from the dropdown below the player.

advanced.title: Advanced effects
advanced.description: Renders Advanced Substation Alpha (SSA/ASS), with karaoke timing, fades, positioning, and custom fonts. Good for music videos, anime, and fan-typeset releases.

editor.title: Convenient editor
editor.description: Time and translate from inside the player. Hotkeys for cue boundaries, with custom positioning, colors and instant preview. Submit or export to SRT when you're done.
